historical_qualification_boundary: W66 qualification remains a separate release hold until its fresh matrix closes.

findings.summary: W71-S02 centralizes symlink-safe canonical path ownership, no-follow reads, and durable cleanup transitions.
limitations: OS-level provider sandboxing remains outside W71-S02.
The local full runner reached 102/102 tests before a known worker hang; remote CI remains the slice-gate authority.

findings.summary: W71-S03 adds fail-closed process supervision, bounded command execution, supported Node 22 enforcement, and complete gate coverage metadata.
limitations: Performance benchmarking is isolated from correctness acceptance until W71-S03.
The local Node 25 runner remains non-authoritative for the full gate; CI Node 22 is the supported verification environment.

findings.summary: W71-S04 makes the prepared Task projection and Start execution route one versioned, durable contract with revision-guarded mutation.
limitations: Existing W70 presentation evidence remains valid only at its documented fixture scope.

findings.summary: W71-S05 moves intent, run, and provider status updates behind lock-scoped, revision-aware transactions with explicit recovery evidence.
limitations: Distributed hosted coordination remains outside the local W71 runtime boundary.

findings.summary: W71-S06 closes delivery, release, integration, route, scope, and evidence validation behind shared fail-closed contracts and immutable lineage checks.
limitations: No real upstream write is permitted as part of remediation evidence.

findings.summary: W71-S07/S10 expose the server-owned Task and provision/integration boundaries; W71-S14 closes the installed Prepare-to-Start-to-Work proof through the public CLI.
limitations: The qualification runner uses a deterministic local provider process; live Codex/Claude provider cells remain the independent W66 release gate.

findings.summary: W71-S08 supplies durable Ask AOR, recovery, review, and completion transitions; W71-S14 verifies installed review approval, integration, patch-only delivery, and learning handoff.
limitations: The qualification runner uses a deterministic local provider process and does not claim live provider behavior; fresh W66 provider cells remain an independent release gate.

findings.summary: W71-S09 hardens multirepo scope locking and isolated measured integration; W71-S10 exposes the public producer path; W71-S14 now proves the installed provision-to-integration-to-no-write-delivery closure.
limitations: The installed closure is provider-free and no-write; paid provider execution and the separate Prepare-to-Work/review-completion claims remain owned by W66-S09 and W71-AUD-006/W71-AUD-007.

findings.summary: W71-S11 resolves qualification bytes through the shared evidence owner, binds current identity and freshness, and proves validator-owned adversarial coverage; paid provider qualification remains a separate release gate.
limitations: Paid provider qualification remains outside deterministic W71 development acceptance.

findings.summary: W71-S12 enforces complete source ownership and non-increasing structural debt; W71-S15 extracts artifact consistency from the largest live-E2E flow and lowers its file ceiling.
limitations: Additional measured hotspots remain separate follow-up work; S15 does not claim complete historical refactoring.

findings.summary: W71-S13 enforces central-AOR-Home guidance, deterministic planning/readiness summaries, bidirectional indexes, and audited story evidence tiers.
limitations: W59 historical closure remains immutable and is not rewritten by W71.
Integrated installed proof remains owned by W71-S14; S13 does not promote affected stories.

findings.summary: The merged Command Desk UI and runtime now have installed real-control-plane and two-repository qualification evidence bound to the same-commit freeze inputs.
limitations: Fresh W66 provider qualification remains an independent release hold.
The sibling UI branch remains an immutable handoff; the integrated runtime evidence is recorded on the S14 candidate.
Installed qualification is provider-free and no-upstream-write; it does not substitute for live provider certification.
